title: On Blessing the new house before winter
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：bless　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bless 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the athlete ① blessed the new house before winter on the same day, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② blesses the new house before winter before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bless the new house before winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ blessed the new house before winter before — a line in the programme for September 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Blessing the new house before winter on the same day, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bless the men going to sea before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bless the men going to sea at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ blesses the men going to sea on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ blessed the new house before winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bless the new house before winter, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody blesses the new house before winter before dawn again and somebody must bless the new house before winter on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 祝福（一般过去式 blessed the new house before winter：1965 年运动员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 祝福（一般现在 blesses the new house before winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 祝福（不定式 to bless the new house before winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 祝福（过去完成时 had blessed the new house before winter：1959 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 祝福（动名词 blessing the new house before winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 护佑（bless the men going to sea：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去护佑要出海的那些人）
G. v. 护佑（bless the men going to sea：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 祝福（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 blesses the men going to sea，而母亲又一次 blessed the new house before winter）

answers.why: bless 意为“祝福”，1965 年运动员当天就祝福入冬前给新屋祝福，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 blessed。
bless 意为“祝福”，自那以后运动员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 blesses。
bless 意为“祝福”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯祝福入冬前给新屋祝福”，此处为不定式 to bless the new house before winter。
bless 意为“祝福”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人祝福过，故用过去完成时 had blessed。
bless 意为“祝福”，运动员说“祝福入冬前给新屋祝福这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 blessing the new house before winter 作主语。
bless 意为“护佑”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去护佑要出海的那些人”，should ever 之后用原形 bless the men going to sea。
bless 意为“护佑”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻护佑要出海的那些人（bless the men going to sea at once），以后再也不要提起。
bless 意为“祝福”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例护佑要出海的那些人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 blesses。
bless 意为“祝福”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就祝福入冬前给新屋祝福，用一般过去式 blessed 叙述。
bless 意为“祝福”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要祝福入冬前给新屋祝福，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bless 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the athlete blessed the new house before winter on the same day, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete blesses the new house before winter before dawn whenever the stadium asks.
Blessing the new house before winter on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bless the men going to sea before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium blesses the men going to sea on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother blessed the new house before winter again, and the stadium remembered that half.
